description:
Free open-source software to boost sound quality, volume, and bass. Including an equalizer, effects, and presets for customized audio.


1. Fixed audio switching away from HDMI when resuming from sleep (#595, #646). When resuming from sleep, FxSound will wait 3 seconds for HDMI connection to restore.
2. Undo button added to the preset dropdown list to revert unsaved changes to the selected preset
3. Fixed device volume getting reset (#655)
4. FxSound relaunches automatically after an application crash
5. GPU rendering can be enabled from settings, with a confirmation prompt before it is applied
6. Windows 7 support restored through a separate build with JUCE 6.1.6
